about: Positive clips per word for stream_heads.py streams and calib: the sources the shipped heads of OpenVoiceOS/wakehubert-wakewords were trained on. Paths are relative to --data-root, or name a folder of a Hugging Face dataset snapshot. exclude drops the evaluation voices: the held-out edge-tts test voices and the Kokoro voices of the test sets.

alexa.positives: TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-alexa original, edge-tts multi-voice and Piper with LibriTTS-R speakers, and OmniVoice clips

hey_mycroft.positives: TigreGotico/synthetic-wakeword-hey_mycroft at revision 026ecd10bb1d7b471b82b56ddf43083a24bf4765, a local copy (edge-tts, Piper with LibriTTS-R speakers, Amazon Polly, OVOS TTS plugins, OmniVoice, Chatterbox and OpenVoice conversions) and further edge-tts and Google Translate TTS clips

hey_jarvis.positives: an edge-tts voice grid, edge-tts and Google Translate TTS voices, and OmniVoice clips
